description: Create or renew an unlisted link only when the user requests sharing. Anyone with the link can read diagram labels. Source quotes/locators are withheld by default; include them only with explicit permission. Use an owned id or supplied spec. Links expire after 30 days. Requires workflow:share; this does not delete the original.

authToken.description: Optional existing session token for non-OAuth transports.

id.description: ID of a saved workflow owned by the current account.

spec.description: A source-cited VisualSpec v0.1. Preserve original excerpts and attribution.

token.description: The unlisted share token returned when creating the link.

name: share_workflow
title: Share Workflow Link
